column1: # B171 probe corpus - WHEN does the engine suffix a conversion
# target with `&`? Trackmania + Openplanet 1.29.14 (next, Public, 6fd4200f), RemoteBuild 127.0.0.1:30000, 2026-09-01.
# verdict and message below is the machine's, never typed.
# B160 adopted `to '{to}&'.` as UNIVERSAL on 22 of 22 messages drawn
# from two corpora that both happened to carry non-const object
# targets. B145 refuted it with one row. This corpus separates the
# THE RULE THAT FITS ALL TEN CONVERSION MESSAGES: the target carries
# `&` iff (1) the source is non-const AND (2) the target type is not a
# primitive AND (3) the slot is an assignable variable, not a return.
# r2 vs r13 is the decisive pair: same conversion, same target type,
# same syntactic slot, differing only in the source's constness, and
# they disagree. r6 is why 'it tracks the slot' also fails.
# shape=n/a means the engine rejected for a DIFFERENT reason and the
# row constrains nothing about spelling. It is not an unsuffixed
# target and must never be counted as one.
# Declared names carry a B171CT token: ~40 plugins share this game and
# a collision would be measured as somebody else's error. The engine
# quotes type names, so the token appears in the messages by design.
